body.title: SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AND RELEASE — SIGNATURE PAGES

body.p: These signature pages belong to the Settlement Agreement and Release that is sent with them in this envelope (the "Agreement"). By signing, each party confirms that it has read the Agreement, had the opportunity to consult counsel, and agrees to be bound by it.
The Agreement may be signed electronically and in counterparts; together they form one agreement. It takes effect when every person below has signed.
[[check:Plaintiff:I have read the entire Agreement, including the release of claims]]
